backend/main.mo: Backend canister managing user state, pairing, profiles, schedules, content filters, activity logs, and admin authorization with multiple persisted maps and types.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented admin login screen enhancements and i18n updates with associated files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing major frontend React components, hooks, and pages used across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading the React app with metadata, icons, and manifest links.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest specifying app metadata, theme colors, icons, and display configuration.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, fetch fallback, and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, admin gate, profile setup flow, dashboards, theming, and login event recording.
frontend/src/components/account/AccountD: Renders a user account dropdown with actions for changing photo, password, viewing policies, and deleting the account. Manages dialog state and displays user name and role.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePa: Dialog that guides users to change their password via Internet Identity. Shows instructions, warnings, and buttons to cancel or open the external service.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePr: Dialog for uploading, previewing, saving, or removing a profile photo with file validation and progress tracking. Uses mutations to save changes and supports clearing the preview.
frontend/src/components/account/DeleteAc: Confirmation dialog for account deletion requiring users to type DELETE. Handles mutation state, warnings, and cancellation.
frontend/src/components/account/UserAvat: Displays a user avatar using either a profile photo or generated initials. Supports different sizes and custom styling.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAcces: Landing screen for admin access with feature descriptions and a password gate. Uses styled panels and localized text.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminBatte: Admin panel showing device battery statuses with icons, colors, and timestamps. Handles loading, empty states, and renders a detailed table.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLogin: Displays login analytics by day, month, or year with inputs and refreshable metrics.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminOverv: Shows admin dashboard summary cards for users, sessions, and battery, with navigation actions.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides admin password verification and password change forms with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSideb: Renders admin sidebar navigation with selectable sections and icons.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsers: Lists parent or child users in a table with loading states and empty handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays multiple aggregated admin metrics as cards with icons and values.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily activity usage versus the limit and allows requesting more time when over limit.
Displays a parent's view of a child's daily activity total and whether it exceeds the configured limit.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays sorted audit log entries with action labels, executor info, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Handles user profile setup, including role selection, phone validation, and protected admin enrollment.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child's activity history in a sortable table with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Lets children submit activity and location check-ins and manage live location sharing.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Renders a consent notice explaining data-sharing context for activity, location, or pairing actions.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Displays a child's location history with filtering tabs and map links, fetching data periodically. Handles loading, empty states, sorting, and optional transparency labeling.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Allows a child to pair with a parent using a code or phone verification, handling validation, URL auto-fill, and pairing status. Manages multiple steps and mutation states.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Provides an interface for parents to edit a child's content filter categories, allowlist, and blocklist. Loads existing config, allows toggling categories, and saves updates.
Shows a read‑only view of a child's configured content filter, including categories and allow/block lists. Handles loading and missing configuration states.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown menu for switching the app's language between supported locales. Uses the i18n hook and displays translated labels.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with copyright, transparency policy link, and a branded attribution link. Uses translations and current hostname for tracking.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the app header with logo, user menus, theme toggle, language selector, and transparency link. Loads user profile to show account controls.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows the child's activity history with a consent notice and auto‑refreshing list. Wraps ActivityHistoryList with an informational alert.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Summary card showing a child's recent activity and location counts, last check‑in time, and selection state. Fetches data periodically for updates.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Displays a child's latest location with timestamps, loading states, and a Google Maps link, using live location and status queries.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Provides tabbed UI for viewing a child's live map or location history with an informational alert.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a pairing code for linking accounts, with copy-to-clipboard and warning UI.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Lets parents view, edit, and save their phone number with validation and profile integration.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Allows parents to edit daily screen-time limits and time windows, loading and saving schedule data.
Shows a child their configured screen-time limits and allowed hours in a read-only view.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Manages a session-based flag indicating whether the admin gate has been passed.
frontend/src/hooks/useBatteryReporting.t: Periodically reports device battery percentage to the backend when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Provides access to the app's internationalization context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity auth, creating AuthClient instances, and handling login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Tracks and periodically submits device location, queues failed updates, and handles visibility and error conditions.
Sends periodic presence heartbeats to the backend and triggers updates on tab visibility changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin data, and related resources.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Implements an i18n provider with language persistence and translation lookup based on supported locales.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports translation maps, supported locales, and shared i18n types.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Contains the English translation strings for all UI text keys.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Provides Portuguese (Brazil) translation strings for authentication, profile setup, admin panels, child/parent dashboards, and transparency policies.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and extensive CSS variables for light/dark navy-themed UI.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty file reserved for Leaflet marker icon configuration.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with sidebar navigation and section-based rendering for overview, users, analytics, and battery panels.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Displays the child’s home dashboard with pairing prompts, supervision notice, and tabs for check-ins, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Shows the parent dashboard with child management, pairing requests, activity/location views, scheduling, filters, audit logs, and alerts.
Renders a modal-style transparency and privacy policies page using i18n text and UI components.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Handles service worker registration and provides helpers for background sync, periodic sync, and retrieving the registration instance.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device and PWA capabilities related to geolocation and background updates, and generates localized capability messages.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: Implements a localStorage-backed queue for batched location updates with retry handling and size limits.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Provides phone number normalization, validation, formatting, parsing, and allowlist comparison utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS themes, colors, fonts, animations, and plugin usage for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project's current state, including requirements, features, admin dashboard goals, and metadata.
